Tooltip_craft_TPFireboxDesc: A low stone firebox with an iron door and a stone-lined hole in its top. Light it like a stove; it cooks like an oven, a pot set in the hole like a hob, its warmth reaches stations within 2 tiles, and it can be banked to make the wood last. Its flue can be joined to a building beside it.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationCore_Seas: Each seasoning goes in once and makes it a little nicer to eat: %1.
Takes %1 of its uses for each of the %2 selected that hasn't had it yet, as much as a stew would.
Tooltip_craft_smokehouseChamberDesc: A plank smokehouse two tiles long under one roof slope, its door on the high end. Hangs up to 6 stacks of what the TP mods smoke (Fish & Meat: Salt Cured fish, salted meat and sausage). With no fire it is still air out of the rain. Join a Stone Hearth beside it (its menu) for smoke. Open air or under an open roof, not in a room.
Tooltip_TraditionalPreservationCore_Forg: A 60 L cauldron of forged iron, greased and blacked. Fit it over a Stone Hearth's hole (its menu) with 2 metal pipes, a heavy chain, a large hook and pliers.
Tooltip_craft_TPCauldronDesc: A 60 L cauldron for the Stone Hearth: two sheets of iron beaten into a pot, a wire bail. Fit it from the Stone Hearth's menu.
